caption: The drawing depicts a single round bowl with a brown interior and a dark rim, set against a plain beige background. The interior of the bowl is decorated with wavy lines in red and green colors. There are several undulating red lines across the inner surface, with one green wavy line near the top and another near the middle, overlapping or parallel to the red lines. The bowl is shown from an overhead viewpoint, filling most of the image, and there are no additional objects or patterns outside the bowl itself.
